data.text:
Here's the full rundown on today's top stocks and why they're lighting up LunarCrush's leaderboard:

La Rosa Holdings $LRHC+19%
A tiny real estate PropTech company that's been plastering headlines: the CEO and COO voluntarily slashed their own salaries by 60% and the company entered a contract to develop a Tier III AI data center, retail loves a CEO who eats their own cooking.

Hims & Hers $HIMS +41%
The big one today. Hims jumped over 40% after announcing a collaboration with Novo Nordisk to sell its popular GLP-1 weight-loss drugs, which also killed a lawsuit between the two companies, enemies to business partners in one weekend.

One and One Green Tech $YDDL +9%
This Philippines-based e-waste recycler has been on a tear from deal flow: the company received a $17 million purchase order from a Japanese supplier and recently expanded into the European market with an e-waste supply agreement in Spain, PCB gold extraction is having a moment.

Vertiv Holdings $VRT +9.5%
Today is Vertiv's first full trading day as an official S&P 500 member, following Friday's rebalancing announcement, passive funds are now required to own it, and the AI data center cooling business behind it is genuinely on fire.

Lumentum $LITE +13%
Same S&P 500 inclusion trade, but Lumentum is the louder mover: shares climbed over 10% in Monday's session, with passive ETFs and index funds forced to buy on the first day of official inclusion, AI photonics is having its main character moment.

uniQure $QURE +24%
Biotech drama at its finest. QURE surged after news broke that Dr. Vinay Prasad, head of the FDA's gene therapy and biologics division, will step down at the end of April, Prasad was the main blocker of uniQure's Huntington's disease gene therapy, so his exit is basically a regulatory jailbreak.

XPENG $XPEV +7%
Investors are positioning ahead of XPeng's Q4 2025 earnings on March 20, with the company guiding for up to 23 billion yuan in revenue, a 43% year-over-year increase, and their upcoming VLA 2.0 autonomous driving system launch has the EV faithful fired up.

BitMine Immersion $BMNR +6%
Pure ETH proxy play. BitMine reported its combined crypto, cash, and investments now total roughly $9.9 billion, including about 4.47 million ETH tokens, giving it control of approximately 3.71% of Ethereum's circulating supply, they're gunning for 5% and calling it "the alchemy."

Sandisk $SNDK +10%
AI storage keeps winning. SNDK has surged over 1,000% post-spin, driven by surging NAND flash demand from AI data centers and industry-wide supply constraints, today's bounce looks like a rebound after last week's broader tech selloff.

SOS Limited $SOS +15%
SOS is building a Tier III modular data center in Texas and recently launched SosBot, an enterprise AI agent platform, but honestly, with a stock this small and volatile, it's probably just riding the broader crypto/AI sentiment wave today alongside BMNR.
